quiz.question: I ___ the door when I heard a loud noise outside.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous menjadi latar belakang aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat aksi pendek (heard) terjadi.

quiz.question: By the time we arrived, the meeting ___.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menandai kejadian yang sudah terjadi SEBELUM kejadian lain di masa lalu (arrived).

quiz.question: She ___ for three hours before she finally finished the report.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous menekankan durasi proses sebelum aksi lain terjadi (finished).

quiz.question: When I was young, I ___ visit my grandparents every summer.
quiz.explanation: 'Used to' bisa dipakai untuk aksi maupun status, sedangkan 'would' hanya untuk aksi berulang, tidak untuk status.

quiz.question: When I was a child, my mother ___ tell me stories every night.
quiz.explanation: 'Would' cocok untuk aksi berulang (bercerita), meski 'used to' juga bisa dipakai di sini.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I used to be a teacher" using 'would' instead — is this correct?
options: No, 'would' cannot be used for states like being a teacher
Yes, 'would be a teacher' is correct
quiz.explanation: 'Would' tidak bisa dipakai untuk status/kondisi (seperti profesi), hanya 'used to' yang bisa.

quiz.question: The thief ___ before the police arrived.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menunjukkan aksi yang selesai sebelum kejadian lain (arrived) di masa lalu.

quiz.question: Choose the correct combination of narrative tenses.
options: While I was walking home, I saw an old friend
While I walked home, I was seeing an old friend
While I had walked home, I saw an old friend
While I have walked home, I saw an old friend
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous (latar) + Past Simple (aksi pendek yang menginterupsi) adalah kombinasi narrative tense yang tepat.

quiz.question: She realized she ___ her keys at home.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menunjukkan aksi (meninggalkan kunci) yang terjadi sebelum aksi lain (realized).

quiz.question: He ___ studying for hours when he finally understood the concept.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous menekankan durasi sebelum titik pemahaman tercapai.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about learning a lesson from a story (Ibrah) with accurate tenses.
options: He had ignored the warning before the disaster struck
He ignored the warning before the disaster had struck (reversed sequence)
He was ignoring the warning before the disaster struck (less precise)
He has ignored the warning before the disaster struck (wrong tense)
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menunjukkan urutan waktu yang jelas: mengabaikan peringatan terjadi SEBELUM bencana.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I had been reading when you called" — is the sequence logical?
options: Yes, reading was ongoing before the call interrupted it
No, it should be Past Simple only
No, it should be Present Perfect
No, the tenses contradict each other
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini benar: aksi panjang (reading) sudah berlangsung sebelum aksi pendek (called) terjadi.

quiz.question: When we ___ dinner, the guests arrived unexpectedly.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous sebagai latar aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat tamu (aksi pendek) tiba.

quiz.question: As a child, I ___ afraid of the dark, but I would never admit it.
quiz.explanation: 'Used to be' cocok untuk status/kondisi (takut), bukan 'would be'.

quiz.question: By the time the sun rose, they ___ their entire journey.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menandai penyelesaian sebelum titik waktu lain di masa lalu (matahari terbit).

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence with accurate storytelling sequence.
options: She had studied hard, so she passed the exam easily
She studied hard, so she had passed the exam easily (reversed)
She was studying hard, so she had passed the exam (unclear sequence)
She has studied hard, so she passed the exam (mismatched tense)
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect (had studied) menunjukkan sebab yang terjadi sebelum akibat (passed) di Past Simple.

quiz.question: He ___ working on this project for months before it was finally approved.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous menekankan durasi panjang sebelum hasil akhir (disetujui) tercapai.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I would be a shy child." (describing a past state)
options: I used to be a shy child
I would be a shy child (wrong as is)
I was used to be a shy child
I have used to be a shy child
quiz.explanation: 'Would' tidak bisa dipakai untuk kondisi/status, hanya 'used to' yang tepat.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence correctly narrating a sequence of past events with accuracy (Amanah).
options: He had already left when I arrived at his house
He already left when I had arrived at his house (reversed)
He was already leaving when I had arrived (unclear sequence)
He has already left when I arrived (mismatched tense)
quiz.explanation: Menjaga akurasi urutan waktu dalam bercerita adalah bagian dari kejujuran ilmiah (Amanah).

quiz.question: While she ___ dinner, the phone rang.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous sebagai latar aksi panjang yang diinterupsi aksi pendek (rang).

quiz.question: They ___ each other for years before they finally got married.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menunjukkan durasi hubungan sebelum peristiwa lain (menikah) di masa lalu.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He had been study for the exam all week."
options: He had been studying for the exam all week
He had study for the exam all week
He has been studying for the exam all week
He was been studying for the exam all week
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous membutuhkan Verb-ing: 'studying'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about a nostalgic habit (action, not state).
options: We would spend hours talking under the stars
We would be close friends since childhood (state, wrong use of would)
We would own a small house by the sea (state, wrong use of would)
We would like to swim as children (ambiguous, less natural)
quiz.explanation: 'Would' cocok untuk aksi berulang di masa lalu (talking), bukan untuk status/kepemilikan.

quiz.question: By the end of the story, the hero ___ his greatest fear.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menandai pencapaian yang selesai sebelum titik akhir cerita.

quiz.question: I ___ waiting for over an hour when the bus finally came.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous menekankan durasi menunggu sebelum bus akhirnya datang.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She had been finish her project before the deadline."
options: She had finished her project before the deadline
She had been finishing her project before the deadline (also valid but different nuance)
She has finished her project before the deadline
She was finished her project before the deadline
quiz.explanation: Untuk menekankan hasil selesai, 'had finished' (Past Perfect) lebih tepat daripada bentuk Continuous di sini.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence maintaining honest, accurate storytelling for a lesson (Ibrah).
options: The companions had faced hardship before victory finally came
The companions faced hardship before victory had finally come (reversed)
The companions were facing hardship before victory came (less precise sequence)
The companions have faced hardship before victory came (mismatched tense)
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect menjaga urutan waktu yang akurat: kesulitan terjadi sebelum kemenangan.

quiz.question: When they finally met, they ___ each other for over ten years.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect negatif menunjukkan durasi tidak bertemu sebelum peristiwa lain (met) di masa lalu.

quiz.question: As children, we ___ play in the garden every afternoon.
quiz.explanation: 'Would' cocok untuk aksi berulang (bermain), bukan status.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about ongoing effort before a result.
options: He had been practicing for years before he finally won the competition
He practiced for years before he had finally won (reversed)
He was practicing for years before he won (less emphasis on duration)
He has practiced for years before he won (mismatched tense)
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous menekankan durasi latihan panjang sebelum kemenangan tercapai.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Past Simple dan Past Continuous bersama untuk aksi utama dan latar belakang. [HINT] Past Continuous untuk aksi panjang, Past Simple untuk interupsi.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Past Perfect untuk menunjukkan urutan kejadian yang jelas. [HINT] had + Verb 3 untuk kejadian sebelum kejadian lain.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menceritakan kebiasaan masa kecilmu, bedakan used to (aksi/status) dan would (hanya aksi). [HINT] would tidak bisa untuk status seperti kepemilikan.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous untuk menekankan durasi sebuah proses sebelum hasil akhir. [HINT] had been + Verb-ing.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menceritakan sebuah kisah pelajaran (Ibrah) dengan urutan waktu yang akurat menggunakan narrative tenses. [HINT] Jaga akurasi urutan waktu sebagai bentuk Amanah.

quiz.question: If I ___ harder in school, I would have a better job now.
quiz.explanation: Mixed Conditional Tipe 1: If + Past Perfect (masa lalu), would + base verb (hasil masa kini).

quiz.question: If she ___ more responsible, she wouldn't have lost her job last year.
quiz.explanation: Mixed Conditional Tipe 2: If + Past Simple (sifat permanen masa kini), would have + V3 (hasil masa lalu).

quiz.question: Choose the correct structure for 'past cause, present result'.
options: If + Past Perfect, would + base verb
If + Past Simple, would have + V3
If + Present Simple, will + base verb
quiz.explanation: Tipe 1 Mixed Conditional: sebab di masa lalu (Past Perfect), hasil di masa kini (would + base verb).

quiz.question: Choose the correct structure for 'present cause, past result'.
options: If + Past Perfect, would + base verb
If + Past Simple, would have + V3
If + Present Simple, will + base verb
quiz.explanation: Tipe 2 Mixed Conditional: sifat masa kini (Past Simple), hasil di masa lalu (would have + V3).

quiz.question: If I ___ afraid of heights, I would have joined you on that climb.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (takut ketinggian) memakai Past Simple 'weren't', hasil di masa lalu memakai would have.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I had worked harder, I would have more money now."
options: This sentence is already correct (mixed conditional)
If I worked harder, I would have more money now (wrong, changes meaning)
If I had worked harder, I would had more money now
If I have worked harder, I would have more money now
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah Mixed Conditional yang benar: sebab masa lalu (had worked), hasil masa kini (would have).

quiz.question: If he ___ more careful, he wouldn't be in the hospital now.
quiz.explanation: Sebab di masa lalu (had been careful) menyebabkan hasil di masa kini (wouldn't be).

quiz.question: Choose the sentence expressing constructive self-evaluation, not just regret.
options: If I had planned better, I would understand the importance of preparation now
If I had planned better, I would cry about it forever
If I planned better yesterday, I regret nothing at all
If I plan better, I would have understood yesterday (mismatched tense)
quiz.explanation: Mixed Conditional bisa dipakai secara konstruktif untuk mengevaluasi keputusan, bukan sekadar meratap.

quiz.question: If she ___ so talented, she wouldn't have won that award years ago.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (bakat) memakai Past Simple 'weren't', hasil di masa lalu memakai would have.

quiz.question: Choose the correct modal variation for uncertainty in mixed conditionals.
options: If I had studied medicine, I might be a doctor now
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now (more certain, also valid)
If I studied medicine, I might have been a doctor now (wrong tense combination)
If I study medicine, I might be a doctor now (wrong tense)
quiz.explanation: 'Might' bisa menggantikan 'would' untuk memberi nuansa ketidakpastian.

quiz.question: Islamic Adab teaches that the word 'Law' (seandainya) should not:
options: open the door to Satan's whispers about the past
be used at all in any context
be used only for happy memories
quiz.explanation: Berandai-andai berlebihan tentang masa lalu bisa membuka celah bisikan setan (penyesalan berlebihan), harus diimbangi dengan menerima takdir.

quiz.question: If they ___ their differences, they wouldn't be enemies today.
quiz.explanation: Sebab masa lalu (had resolved) berdampak pada hasil masa kini (wouldn't be).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I was rich, I would have bought that house last year."
options: If I had been rich, I would have bought that house last year
If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year (also valid mixed form)
If I am rich, I would have bought that house last year
If I was rich, I will buy that house last year
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen 'kaya' bisa dinyatakan dengan Past Simple 'were', dan hasil masa lalu memakai 'would have'.

quiz.question: If he ___ so stubborn, he would have accepted the advice back then.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (keras kepala) memakai Past Simple 'weren't'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting Tawakkal after making a mixed conditional statement.
options: If I had chosen differently, things might be different now, but I trust Allah's plan
If I had chosen differently, I would blame myself forever
If only things were different, I refuse to accept reality
If I had chosen differently, nothing else matters now
quiz.explanation: Tawakkal berarti menerima bahwa hasil akhir tetaplah kehendak Allah, meski kita tetap merenungi keputusan masa lalu.

quiz.question: If she ___ to that school, she would have different friends now.
quiz.explanation: Sebab masa lalu (had gone) memengaruhi hasil masa kini (would have).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I am more patient, I wouldn't have argued with him that day."
options: If I were more patient, I wouldn't have argued with him that day
If I am more patient, I won't have argued with him that day
If I was more patient, I don't argue with him that day
If I had been more patient, I wouldn't argued with him that day
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (sabar) memakai Past Simple 'were', hasil masa lalu memakai 'would have'.

quiz.question: If he ___ so generous, he wouldn't have donated his savings last year.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (dermawan) memakai Past Simple 'weren't'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct mixed conditional about a past decision affecting the present.
options: If I had taken that job, I would be living abroad now
If I take that job, I would be living abroad now
If I had taken that job, I will be living abroad now
If I took that job, I would have been living abroad now
quiz.explanation: Tipe 1: sebab masa lalu (had taken), hasil masa kini (would be living).

quiz.question: If they ___ so kind, they wouldn't have helped us during that hardship.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (baik hati) memakai Past Simple 'weren't', hasil masa lalu memakai 'would have'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I had believed in myself, I would has more confidence now."
options: If I had believed in myself, I would have more confidence now
If I believed in myself, I would has more confidence now
If I had believed in myself, I would had more confidence now
If I have believed in myself, I would have more confidence now
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'would', kata kerja dasar 'have', bukan 'has'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct mixed conditional for a present trait causing a past outcome.
options: If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken up at the meeting
If she hadn't been so shy, she would speak up at the meeting
If she isn't so shy, she would have spoken up at the meeting
If she wasn't so shy, she will speak up at the meeting
quiz.explanation: Tipe 2: sifat permanen (pemalu) di Past Simple, hasil masa lalu di would have.

quiz.question: If we ___ more prepared, we wouldn't be struggling with this now.
quiz.explanation: Sebab masa lalu (had been prepared) berdampak pada hasil masa kini (wouldn't be struggling).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I weren't so lazy, I would have finished it last week."
options: If I wasn't so lazy, I would finished it last week
If I hadn't been so lazy, I would finish it last week
If I weren't so lazy, I will have finished it last week
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini sudah benar sebagai Mixed Conditional Tipe 2.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence with a constructive evaluation tone rather than despair.
options: If I had been more careful with money, I would have savings now — a lesson for the future
If I had been more careful with money, my life is ruined forever
If only I had money, nothing would matter anymore
If I had been more careful, I refuse to think about it
quiz.explanation: Evaluasi diri yang konstruktif mengambil pelajaran, bukan berlarut dalam penyesalan.

quiz.question: If he ___ so ambitious, he wouldn't have taken that risk years ago.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (ambisius) memakai Past Simple 'weren't'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I had listened to my parents, I would has avoided that mistake."
options: If I had listened to my parents, I would have avoided that mistake
If I listened to my parents, I would has avoided that mistake
If I had listened to my parents, I would had avoided that mistake
If I have listened to my parents, I would have avoided that mistake
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'would', kata kerja dasar 'have avoided', bukan 'has'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about accepting the past with Tawakkal while still learning from it.
options: If things had gone differently, I might be somewhere else now, but I trust this is where Allah wants me
If things had gone differently, I would never forgive myself
If only things were different, I refuse this reality
If things had gone differently, nothing would matter
quiz.explanation: Tawakkal berarti berserah pada ketentuan Allah sambil tetap mengambil pelajaran.

quiz.question: If she ___ so disciplined, she wouldn't have achieved so much by now.
quiz.explanation: Sifat permanen (disiplin) memakai Past Simple 'weren't'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct combination expressing a past cause with present emotional result.
options: If I hadn't lost that opportunity, I wouldn't feel this regret now
If I don't lose that opportunity, I wouldn't feel this regret now
If I hadn't lost that opportunity, I won't feel this regret now
If I lost that opportunity, I wouldn't have felt this regret now
quiz.explanation: Tipe 1: sebab masa lalu (hadn't lost), hasil masa kini (wouldn't feel).

quiz.question: The bridge ___ built right now; please use the other route.
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous (Be + Being + V3) menunjukkan proses yang sedang berlangsung sekarang.

quiz.question: The report ___ written when the fire broke out.
quiz.explanation: 'Was being' menunjukkan proses yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu.

quiz.question: It ___ said that honesty is the best policy.
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive 'It is said that...' dipakai untuk menyampaikan opini/fakta umum.

quiz.question: He ___ thought to be one of the best scholars of his time.
quiz.explanation: 'Is thought to be' adalah pola impersonal passive untuk pendapat umum.

quiz.question: The rules ___ be followed by everyone without exception.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'must' + Be + V3 untuk passive dengan modal.

quiz.question: This document ___ signed before the deadline.
quiz.explanation: Struktur Passive with Modals: Modal + Be + V3.

quiz.question: He ___ fired from his job last month.
quiz.explanation: 'Got' passive (informal) dipakai untuk menekankan perubahan status di masa lalu.

quiz.question: Choose the more formal alternative to "He got married last year."
options: He has got married last year (less standard)
quiz.explanation: 'Was married' adalah bentuk formal, sedangkan 'got married' lebih informal.

quiz.question: It ___ reported that the event was a great success.
quiz.explanation: 'It is reported that...' adalah pola standar jurnalisme untuk menyampaikan fakta secara objektif.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence maintaining Sidiq (honesty) when reporting news objectively.
options: It is reported that the situation has improved
Someone told me the situation has improved (less formal/objective)
The situation improved, I guess (uncertain, less objective)
I think the situation improved somehow (subjective)
quiz.explanation: Impersonal passive membantu menyampaikan fakta secara proporsional dan objektif, sesuai adab Sidiq.

quiz.question: The new policy ___ implemented starting next month.
quiz.explanation: Passive with modal 'will': will + be + V3.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The car is being repair at the shop."
options: The car is being repaired at the shop
The car is repair at the shop
The car was being repair at the shop
The car is been repaired at the shop
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous membutuhkan Verb 3: 'repaired'.

quiz.question: The building ___ being renovated when the storm hit.
quiz.explanation: 'Was being renovated' menunjukkan proses yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence using 'get' for an unexpected event.
quiz.explanation: 'Got stolen' menekankan perubahan status yang tidak terduga di masa lalu.

quiz.question: This task ___ completed by the end of the week.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'should' + Be + V3 untuk passive dengan modal.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It is say that patience brings success."
options: It is said that patience brings success
It says that patience brings success
It is saying that patience brings success
It has say that patience brings success
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive membutuhkan Verb 3: 'said'.

quiz.question: The news ___ being broadcast live right now.
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous present: 'is being broadcast'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about a rule that must be obeyed.
options: The rule must be respected by all members
The rule must respected by all members
The rule musts be respected by all members
The rule must be respect by all members
quiz.explanation: Modal + Be + V3: 'must be respected'.

quiz.question: He is believed ___ the most knowledgeable person in the village.
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive 'is believed to be' adalah pola standar.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She got promote last year."
quiz.explanation: 'Get' passive membutuhkan Verb 3: 'promoted'.

quiz.question: This matter ___ be handled with great care.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'should' tidak berubah bentuk apa pun.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reporting information proportionally and honestly.
options: It is reported that the crops were affected by the drought
Everyone says the crops were totally destroyed (exaggerated, less honest)
I heard the crops are completely gone (unverified rumor)
The crops were affected, probably, who knows (vague, unreliable)
quiz.explanation: Menyampaikan fakta secara proporsional adalah bagian dari amanah dalam menyampaikan berita.

quiz.question: The letter ___ delivered by tomorrow morning.
quiz.explanation: Passive with modal 'will': will + be + V3.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The house was being build when the storm hit."
options: The house was being built when the storm hit
The house was build when the storm hit
The house is being built when the storm hit
The house has being built when the storm hit
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous membutuhkan Verb 3: 'built'.

quiz.question: It ___ known that patience is a virtue in Islam.
quiz.explanation: 'It is known that...' adalah pola impersonal passive untuk fakta umum.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about a task that can possibly be done.
options: This problem can be solved with patience
This problem can solved with patience
This problem cans be solved with patience
This problem can be solve with patience
quiz.explanation: Modal 'can' + Be + V3: 'can be solved'.

quiz.question: He got ___ during the community service event.
quiz.explanation: 'Get' passive membutuhkan Verb 3: 'injured'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The rules must to be followed strictly."
options: The rules must be followed strictly
The rules musts be followed strictly
The rules must to followed strictly
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal 'must', tidak ada 'to' sebelum 'be'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct passive sentence about ongoing construction.
options: The mosque is being expanded to accommodate more worshippers
The mosque is expand to accommodate more worshippers
The mosque expanding to accommodate more worshippers
The mosque has being expanded to accommodate more worshippers
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous present: 'is being expanded'.

quiz.question: It ___ believed that hard work leads to success.
quiz.explanation: 'It is believed that...' adalah pola impersonal passive standar.

quiz.question: This time tomorrow, I ___ on a plane to Mecca.
quiz.explanation: Future Continuous (will be + Verb-ing) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan.

quiz.question: By next year, I ___ my studies.
quiz.explanation: Future Perfect (will have + V3) menunjukkan aksi yang akan sudah selesai sebelum titik waktu tertentu.

quiz.question: By the time you arrive, we ___ dinner.
quiz.explanation: Future Perfect menunjukkan aksi yang akan selesai sebelum kejadian lain (kamu tiba).

quiz.question: At 8 PM tonight, I ___ my favorite show.

quiz.explanation: Husnudzon berarti berprasangka baik terhadap orang lain, bukan menuduh tanpa dasar.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting Husnudzon rather than harsh judgment.
options: He might have had a good reason for being late
He must have been irresponsible for being late
He can't have any good excuse for being late
He should have never been late, no excuses
quiz.explanation: 'Might have' mencerminkan sikap berprasangka baik dan tidak cepat menuduh.

quiz.question: I heard a noise; someone ___ knocked on the door.
quiz.explanation: 'Might have' dipakai karena kita hanya menduga, belum yakin sepenuhnya.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She can't has known about the surprise."
options: She can't have known about the surprise
She cants have known about the surprise
She can't had known about the surprise
She can't having known about the surprise
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal 'can't', kata bantu selalu 'have'.

quiz.question: He was the only one with the key; he ___ locked the door.
quiz.explanation: 'Must have' berdasarkan bukti kuat (hanya dia yang punya kunci).

quiz.question: Choose the sentence expressing regret about a missed opportunity.
options: I should have taken that job when I had the chance
I should has taken that job when I had the chance
I should have took that job when I had the chance
I shoulds have taken that job when I had the chance
quiz.explanation: 'Should have' + Verb 3 dipakai untuk penyesalan tentang sesuatu yang seharusnya dilakukan tapi tidak.

quiz.question: The witnesses saw someone else; he ___ committed the crime.
quiz.explanation: 'Can't have' menunjukkan ketidakmungkinan berdasarkan bukti (saksi melihat orang lain).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "They might has forgotten to lock the door."
options: They might have forgotten to lock the door
They mights have forgotten to lock the door
They might had forgotten to lock the door
They might having forgotten to lock the door
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal 'might', kata bantu selalu 'have'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence avoiding hasty accusation with limited evidence.
options: We don't know for sure; he might have had a valid reason
We know for sure; he must have lied to us
We know for sure; he can't have told the truth
We are certain; he should have been more honest, no excuses
quiz.explanation: Dengan bukti terbatas, sikap Husnudzon mendorong kita memilih 'might have' daripada menuduh langsung.

quiz.question: She scored perfectly; she ___ studied very hard.
quiz.explanation: 'Must have' untuk kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan hasil (nilai sempurna).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He should has apologized for his mistake."
options: He should have apologized for his mistake
He shoulds have apologized for his mistake
He should had apologized for his mistake
He should having apologized for his mistake
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal 'should', kata bantu selalu 'have'.

quiz.question: The engine is completely destroyed; the fire ___ started here.
quiz.explanation: 'Must have' untuk kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan bukti fisik yang jelas.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about a possibility we're not certain about, avoiding Su'udzon.
options: She might have missed the bus; that's probably why she's late
She must have been careless; that's why she's late
She can't have any excuse for being late
She should never be late, there's no reason acceptable
quiz.explanation: 'Might have' menunjukkan kemungkinan tanpa terburu-buru menghakimi.

quiz.question: He wasn't even in the country; he ___ done this.
quiz.explanation: 'Can't have' menunjukkan ketidakmungkinan mutlak berdasarkan fakta (tidak berada di negara itu).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I must have forget my phone at home."
options: I must have forgotten my phone at home
I must has forgotten my phone at home
I must have forgot my phone at home
I musts have forgotten my phone at home
quiz.explanation: 'Forgotten' adalah bentuk Verb 3 dari 'forget', bukan 'forget' atau 'forgot'.

quiz.question: She seemed very happy; something good ___ happened to her.
quiz.explanation: 'Must have' untuk kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan ekspresi bahagianya.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence expressing regret about a past mistake constructively.
options: I shouldn't have said that; I've learned to think before speaking
I shouldn't have said that; I will never forgive myself
I shouldn't have said that; it's pointless now
I shouldn't have said that; nothing matters anymore
quiz.explanation: Penyesalan yang konstruktif mengarah pada perbaikan diri, bukan keputusasaan.

quiz.question: The room was locked from the inside; no one ___ entered from outside.
quiz.explanation: 'Can't have' menunjukkan ketidakmungkinan berdasarkan bukti kuat (kunci dari dalam).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "We might have misunderstand the instructions."
options: We might have misunderstood the instructions
We might has misunderstood the instructions
We might have misunderstand the instructions (wrong as is)
We mights have misunderstood the instructions
quiz.explanation: 'Misunderstood' adalah bentuk Verb 3 dari 'misunderstand'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting careful judgment about someone's silence.
options: He might have been busy; that's probably why he didn't reply
He must have been ignoring us on purpose
He can't have had any reason to not reply
He should have replied immediately, no excuses accepted
quiz.explanation: Memilih 'might have' mencerminkan Husnudzon, tidak buru-buru menuduh niat buruk.

quiz.question: I regret not visiting him when I had the chance; I ___ gone to see him.
quiz.explanation: 'Should have' + Verb 3 menyatakan penyesalan tentang sesuatu yang seharusnya dilakukan.

quiz.question: I ___ my car repaired last week.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' menunjukkan kita meminta orang lain melakukan pekerjaan tersebut.

quiz.question: She ___ her hair cut yesterday at the salon.
quiz.explanation: Struktur 'have + object + Verb 3' menunjukkan kita membayar/meminta orang lain melakukannya.

quiz.question: Choose the correct structure for 'Have something done'.
quiz.explanation: Rumus causative 'have': Have + Object + Past Participle (Verb 3).

quiz.question: I finally ___ him agree to help with the project.
quiz.explanation: 'Get' causative menunjukkan ada usaha/persuasi untuk membuat sesuatu terjadi.

quiz.question: Choose the correct 'Get' causative structure.
quiz.explanation: Struktur 'get' causative aktif adalah Get + Object + to + Verb 1.

quiz.question: I ___ my brother fix the computer yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Active causative dengan 'have': Have + Person + Verb 1 (tanpa 'to').

quiz.question: I ___ my sister to help me with the presentation.
quiz.explanation: Active causative dengan 'get': Get + Person + to + Verb 1.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I had my brother to fix the computer."
options: I had my brother fix the computer
I got my brother to fix the computer
I had my brother fixed the computer
I had my brother fixing the computer
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'have + person', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to': 'fix'.

quiz.question: He ___ his wallet stolen on the bus yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Causative 'have' juga dipakai untuk kejadian buruk yang tidak direncanakan (unpleasant experience).

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about an unpleasant unplanned event.
options: I had my phone stolen at the market
I have my phone stolen at the market (wrong tense)
I had my phone steal at the market
I had my phone stealing at the market
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' bisa dipakai untuk kejadian buruk yang menimpa kita, seperti kehilangan barang.

quiz.question: We should always ___ our brothers in faith with good deeds (Ta'awun).
quiz.explanation: Ini bukan struktur causative, tapi menegaskan pentingnya tolong-menolong (Ta'awun) dalam kebaikan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She got her essay to check by her teacher."
options: She got her essay checked by her teacher
She got her essay check by her teacher
She got her essay checking by her teacher
She had her essay to check by her teacher
quiz.explanation: 'Get something done' membutuhkan Verb 3: 'checked'.

quiz.question: I need to ___ my shoes cleaned before the event.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' dipakai untuk meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita.

quiz.question: He ___ his colleague to submit the report on time.
quiz.explanation: 'Get' causative menunjukkan ada usaha membujuk agar orang lain melakukan sesuatu.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about delegating a task without doing it yourself.
options: I had the mechanic check my car
I have the mechanic checked my car
I had the mechanic to check my car
I had the mechanic checking my car
quiz.explanation: Active causative: Have + Person + Verb 1 (tanpa to).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She had her house paint last month."
options: She had her house painted last month
She had her house paint last month (wrong as is)
She had her house painting last month
She had her house to paint last month
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' membutuhkan Verb 3: 'painted'.

quiz.question: Ta'awun in Islam means:
options: mutual cooperation and helping one another in good deeds
quiz.explanation: Ta'awun adalah prinsip tolong-menolong dalam kebaikan antar sesama Muslim.

quiz.question: I ___ my documents translated before the interview.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' dipakai karena kita meminta jasa penerjemah, bukan melakukan sendiri.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting cooperative help (Ta'awun in causative context).
options: I got my friend to help me move house, and I helped him back last week
I made my friend help me move house against his will
I forced my friend to help me move house
I never asked anyone to help me move house
quiz.explanation: Ta'awun tercermin dari saling membantu dengan tulus dan timbal balik.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He got his suit made for the wedding by tailor."
options: He got his suit made for the wedding by a tailor
He got his suit make for the wedding by a tailor
He got his suit making for the wedding by a tailor
He had his suit make for the wedding by a tailor
quiz.explanation: Struktur sudah benar, hanya perlu artikel 'a' sebelum 'tailor': 'by a tailor'.

quiz.question: She ___ her passport renewed before the trip.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' untuk layanan yang dilakukan pihak berwenang (kantor imigrasi).

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about an unfortunate accident.
options: He had his leg broken in the accident
He has his leg broken in the accident (wrong tense)
He had his leg break in the accident
He had his leg breaking in the accident
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' bisa dipakai untuk pengalaman buruk yang menimpa (kecelakaan).

quiz.question: I ___ my neighbor to water my plants while I was away.
quiz.explanation: 'Get' menunjukkan ada usaha meyakinkan tetangga untuk melakukannya.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "We had our roof repair after the storm."
options: We had our roof repaired after the storm
We had our roof repair after the storm (wrong as is)
We had our roof repairing after the storm
We had our roof to repair after the storm
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' membutuhkan Verb 3: 'repaired'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about mutual help in the community (Ta'awun) using causative structure.
options: The neighbors got each other to help during the harvest season
The neighbors made each other help during the harvest season
The neighbors forced each other during the harvest season
The neighbors ignored each other during the harvest season
quiz.explanation: Ta'awun tercermin dari saling membantu dengan sukarela dalam komunitas.

quiz.question: I ___ my computer fixed by a technician yesterday.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' menunjukkan pekerjaan dilakukan oleh pihak lain (teknisi).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She got him agreeing to the plan finally."
options: She got him to agree to the plan finally
She got him agree to the plan finally
She had him agreeing to the plan finally
She made him to agree to the plan finally
quiz.explanation: 'Get' causative aktif: Get + Person + to + Verb 1.

quiz.question: He ___ his wallet lost while traveling last month.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' (unpleasant experience) untuk kejadian buruk yang tidak direncanakan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about seeking professional help for repairs.
options: We had the plumber fix the leaking pipe
We had the plumber to fix the leaking pipe
We had the plumber fixed the leaking pipe
We had the plumber fixing the leaking pipe
quiz.explanation: Active causative: Have + Person + Verb 1 (tanpa to).

quiz.question: I ___ my dress altered for the special occasion.
quiz.explanation: 'Have something done' untuk jasa yang dilakukan orang lain (penjahit).

quiz.question: I stopped ___ to visit my grandmother; I go every week now.
quiz.explanation: 'Stop + to V1' berarti berhenti melakukan aksi A untuk melakukan aksi B (visiting).

quiz.question: He stopped ___; it's bad for his health.
quiz.explanation: 'Stop + Gerund' berarti berhenti dari kebiasaan itu sendiri (berhenti merokok).

quiz.question: I remember ___ this place when I was a child.
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + Gerund' berarti mengingat kenangan masa lalu (Syukur atas masa lalu).

quiz.question: Please remember ___ the door before you leave.
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + Infinitive' berarti mengingat untuk melakukan sesuatu di masa depan (Amanah masa depan).

quiz.question: I tried ___ the door, but it was too heavy.
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Infinitive' berarti berusaha keras melakukan sesuatu yang sulit.

quiz.question: Why don't you try ___ a different approach? It might work.
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Gerund' berarti bereksperimen dengan sesuatu untuk melihat hasilnya.

quiz.question: We regret ___ you that the event has been cancelled.
quiz.explanation: 'Regret + Infinitive' dipakai dalam pengumuman formal untuk menyampaikan kabar buruk.

quiz.question: I regret ___ so harshly to him years ago.
quiz.explanation: 'Regret + Gerund' berarti menyesali sesuatu yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu.

quiz.question: He went on ___ his story after the interruption.
quiz.explanation: 'Go on + Gerund' berarti melanjutkan aktivitas yang sedang dilakukan.

quiz.question: After finishing his studies, he went on ___ a successful business.
quiz.explanation: 'Go on + Infinitive' berarti melanjutkan ke aksi baru yang berbeda (mengubah aksi).

quiz.question: Every deed begins with Niyyah (intention); this is reflected in the distinction between 'remember to do' and:
quiz.explanation: 'Remember to do' (niat masa depan) dan 'remember doing' (kenangan masa lalu, syukur) menunjukkan pentingnya niat dalam setiap perbuatan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I stopped to eat sweets" (meaning: quit the habit).
options: I stopped to eat sweets (wrong as is for this meaning)
quiz.explanation: Untuk 'berhenti dari kebiasaan', gunakan Gerund: 'stopped eating'.

quiz.question: She tried ___ a new recipe to see if her family would like it.
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Gerund' berarti bereksperimen dengan sesuatu yang baru.

quiz.question: We regret ___ that the flight has been delayed.
quiz.explanation: 'Regret + Infinitive' dipakai untuk pengumuman formal tentang kabar buruk.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about continuing a lecture after a pause.
options: The teacher went on explaining the lesson
The teacher went on to explain a different topic (changes topic, different meaning)
The teacher went on explain the lesson
The teacher went on to explaining the lesson
quiz.explanation: 'Go on + Gerund' berarti melanjutkan aktivitas yang sama (menjelaskan pelajaran yang sama).

quiz.question: I always try ___ patient, even when things are difficult.
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Infinitive' menunjukkan usaha sungguh-sungguh untuk melakukan sesuatu yang sulit (sabar).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I remember to visit that place as a child." (recalling a memory)
options: I remember visiting that place as a child
I remember to visit that place as a child (wrong as is for this meaning)
I remember visit that place as a child
I remembered to visit that place as a child
quiz.explanation: Untuk mengingat kenangan masa lalu, gunakan Gerund: 'remember visiting'.

quiz.question: Please remember ___ your intention (Niyyah) before doing any good deed.
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + Infinitive' untuk pengingat tentang sesuatu yang harus dilakukan (niat sebelum beramal).

quiz.question: He stopped ___ for a moment to greet an old friend on the street.
quiz.explanation: 'Stop + Infinitive' berarti berhenti dari aksi A (berjalan) untuk melakukan aksi B (menyapa).

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about experimenting with a new method.
options: Let's try using this new method and see if it helps
Let's try to use this new method to overcome great difficulty (different nuance)
Let's try use this new method
Let's try used this new method
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Gerund' cocok untuk bereksperimen dengan metode baru.

quiz.question: We regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
quiz.explanation: 'Regret + Infinitive' untuk pengumuman formal kabar kurang menyenangkan.

quiz.question: After the meeting, she went on ___ several other projects that year.
quiz.explanation: 'Go on + Infinitive' berarti melanjutkan ke aksi/pencapaian baru yang berbeda.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I try to learn a new language, just to see if I'd enjoy it." (experimenting, not effortful struggle)
options: I tried learning a new language, just to see if I'd enjoy it
I try to learn a new language (wrong as is for this meaning)
I tried learn a new language
I try learning to a new language
quiz.explanation: Untuk sekadar mencoba/bereksperimen, gunakan Gerund: 'tried learning'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting sincerity of intention (Niyyah) in good deeds.
options: Remember to purify your intention before helping others sincerely
Remember purifying your intention before helping others (wrong nuance)
Remember purify your intention before helping others
Remembering to purify your intention before helping others
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + Infinitive' menekankan pengingat untuk melakukan sesuatu (memurnikan niat) sebelum bertindak.

quiz.question: He tried ___ the lock, but nothing worked.
options: picking (experimenting, less fitting for a struggle)
quiz.explanation: 'Try + Infinitive' menunjukkan usaha keras melakukan sesuatu yang sulit (membuka kunci).

quiz.question: I stopped ___ midway through the project because it wasn't working out.
quiz.explanation: 'Stop + Gerund' berarti berhenti dari aktivitas itu sendiri (bekerja pada proyek).

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about grateful recollection of a childhood memory.
options: I remember learning to recite my first surah with my mother
I remember to learn my first surah with my mother (wrong nuance)
I remembered learn my first surah with my mother
I remember to learning my first surah with my mother
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + Gerund' cocok untuk kenangan masa lalu yang disyukuri.

quiz.question: We regret ___ that the venue has changed at the last minute.
quiz.explanation: 'Regret + Infinitive' untuk pengumuman formal kabar kurang menyenangkan.

quiz.question: The scholar went on ___ his lecture despite the noise outside.
options: to give (would change topic, wrong here)
quiz.explanation: 'Go on + Gerund' berarti melanjutkan aktivitas yang sama (ceramah yang sedang berlangsung).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He tried opening the heavy door with all his strength, but it wouldn't budge." (struggling with a difficult task)
options: He tried to open the heavy door with all his strength, but it wouldn't budge
He tried opening the heavy door with all his strength (wrong nuance for this context)
He try to open the heavy door with all his strength
He tried open the heavy door with all his strength
quiz.explanation: Untuk usaha keras melakukan sesuatu yang sulit, gunakan Infinitive: 'tried to open'.

quiz.question: He said, "I am tired." → He said (that) he ___ tired.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: Present Simple 'am' menjadi Past Simple 'was' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: She said, "I will call you." → She said (that) she ___ call me.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: 'will' menjadi 'would' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: He said, "I have finished." → He said (that) he ___ finished.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: Present Perfect 'have' menjadi Past Perfect 'had'.

quiz.question: Choose a more descriptive reporting verb instead of monotonous 'say'.
quiz.explanation: 'Complained' menunjukkan nada/maksud pembicara secara lebih spesifik daripada 'say' yang monoton.

quiz.question: She asked, "Where do you live?" → She asked where I ___.
quiz.explanation: Reported questions tidak memakai inversi/do-support; backshift ke Past Simple 'lived'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He asked what did I want."
options: He asked what did I wanted
quiz.explanation: Reported questions kembali ke pola kalimat berita (Subjek + Verb) tanpa 'did'.

quiz.question: The teacher told the students ___ their books.
quiz.explanation: Melaporkan perintah: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1.

quiz.question: He ordered his employees ___ late.
quiz.explanation: Negasi perintah tidak langsung: Verb + Object + NOT TO + V1.

quiz.question: Choose the correct backshift: "I can swim." → He said he ___ swim.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: 'can' menjadi 'could' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: Choose the correct backshift: "I saw him yesterday." → She said she ___ him the day before.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: Past Simple 'saw' menjadi Past Perfect 'had seen'.

quiz.question: In Islam, accurately relaying someone's message (Amanah) means we should not:
options: distort facts or twist the original meaning of the speaker
always use exact word-for-word quotes only
quiz.explanation: Amanah dalam menyampaikan pesan berarti tidak memutarbalikkan fakta atau maksud asli pembicara.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He told me that he will come tomorrow." (reported in the past)
options: He told me that he would come the next day
He told me that he will come the next day (missing backshift)
He told me that he comes the next day
He told me that he would came the next day
quiz.explanation: Backshift: 'will' menjadi 'would', dan 'tomorrow' menjadi 'the next day'.

quiz.question: She asked me, "Are you coming?" → She asked if I ___ coming.
quiz.explanation: Reported yes/no questions memakai 'if/whether'; backshift 'am' menjadi 'was'.

quiz.question: The doctor advised him ___ more water.
quiz.explanation: Melaporkan saran: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1.

quiz.question: Choose the correct reporting verb for someone who spoke in a warning tone.
quiz.explanation: 'Warned' menunjukkan nada peringatan, lebih deskriptif daripada 'said'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She asked me where did I go."
options: She asked me where I went
She asked me where I go
She asked me where went I
She asked me where did I went
quiz.explanation: Reported questions tidak memakai inversi; backshift ke Past Simple 'went'.

quiz.question: He said, "I am going to visit Mecca." → He said he ___ going to visit Mecca.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: 'am' menjadi 'was'.

quiz.question: The manager instructed the staff ___ the reports on time.
quiz.explanation: Melaporkan instruksi: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence maintaining faithful transmission of a message (Amanah).
options: He accurately reported what the scholar had said, without changing the meaning
He exaggerated what the scholar said to make it more interesting
He changed a few words because he forgot the exact message
He only reported the parts he agreed with
quiz.explanation: Menyampaikan pesan dengan akurat, tanpa distorsi, adalah bentuk amanah.

quiz.question: She said, "This is my book." → She said (that) ___ was her book.
quiz.explanation: Backshift juga mengubah 'this' menjadi 'that' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He asked her can she help him."
options: He asked her if she could help him
He asked her if she can help him
He asked her could she help him
He asked her if could she help him
quiz.explanation: Reported yes/no question memakai 'if', tanpa inversi, dan backshift 'can' menjadi 'could'.

quiz.question: The Imam requested the congregation ___ quiet during the sermon.
quiz.explanation: Melaporkan permintaan: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1.

quiz.question: Choose the descriptive reporting verb for someone who spoke with enthusiasm.
quiz.explanation: 'Exclaimed' menunjukkan nada bersemangat, lebih deskriptif daripada 'said'.

quiz.question: He said, "I must leave now." → He said he ___ leave then.
quiz.explanation: Backshift: 'must' (kewajiban) sering menjadi 'had to' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She told to me that she was tired."
options: She told me that she was tired
She told that me she was tired
She said to me that she were tired
She tells me that she was tired
quiz.explanation: 'Tell' langsung diikuti objek tanpa 'to': 'told me'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct reported command using proper structure.
options: The teacher told the students to be quiet
The teacher told the students be quiet
The teacher told to the students to be quiet
The teacher told the students being quiet
quiz.explanation: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1 adalah struktur yang benar untuk perintah.

quiz.question: He said, "I bought this yesterday." → He said he had bought that ___.
quiz.explanation: Backshift keterangan waktu: 'yesterday' menjadi 'the day before'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence correctly reporting a request for help.
options: She asked him to help her with the luggage
She asked him help her with the luggage
She asked him helping her with the luggage
She asked to him help her with the luggage
quiz.explanation: Reporting Verb + Object + TO + V1 untuk permintaan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He asked where is the nearest mosque."
options: He asked where the nearest mosque was
He asked where is the nearest mosque (wrong as is)
He asked where the nearest mosque is
He asked where was the nearest mosque
quiz.explanation: Reported question tanpa inversi, backshift 'is' menjadi 'was'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence emphasizing honesty when relaying someone's exact intention.
options: I made sure to report his words accurately, without adding my own opinion
I added my own interpretation to make his words sound better
I only shared parts of his message that I liked
I changed his tone to match what I wanted to convey
quiz.explanation: Amanah dalam menyampaikan pesan berarti menjaga keakuratan tanpa menambah opini pribadi.
